newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity launches three Advisor and VIP III funds.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity launches three Advisor and VIP III funds.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Thursday it launched three mutual funds, adding to its Fidelity Advisor and Variable Insurance Products Fund III (VIP III) line of funds.

The new funds are Fidelity Advisor TechnoQuant Growth Fund, managed by Tim Krochuk, Fidelity Advisor Growth & Income Fund, managed by Beth Terrana, and VIP III: Growth & Income Portfolio, also managed by Terrana.
Fidelity also renamed three funds. The Fidelity Advisor Income and Growth Fund is now the Fidelity Advisor Balanced Fund and will continue to be managed by Bettina Doulton and Kevin Grant.
Two VIP III funds, which are underlying fund options for variable annuity and variable life separate accounts, were also renamed.

Fidelity Advisor Annuity Growth Oportunities was renamed VIP III: Growth Opportunities Portfolio, and will continue to be managed by George Vanderheiden. Fidelity Advisor Annuity Income and Growth was changed to VIP III: Balanced Portfolio and will continue to be managed by Doulton and Grant.
